detection_prospects.note: Bounce predicts homogeneous ALP field → isotropic-only signal. Anisotropic component suppressed by (δφ/Δφ)² ~ 10^{-10}. Absence of anisotropic birefringence is CONSISTENT with bounce.

key_result: The bounce model predicts negligible anisotropic birefringence (A_CB ~ 7.3e-15 deg², ~10^{12}x below Planck sensitivity). The detectable signal is purely isotropic (β ≈ 0.27°), consistent with a spatially homogeneous ALP condensate at the bounce epoch. This is a testable prediction: detection of significant anisotropic birefringence would EXCLUDE the bounce-ALP interpretation.
